notes: Trigger evals. Run with the skill-creator plugin's run_eval.py; pin a cheap model explicitly (defaults inherit the session model). expected_skill: null means the skill must NOT fire. Every prompt naming a document MUST reference evals/files/draft-spec.md and that file must exist in the run's working directory: a prompt pointing at a document that is not there makes the model ask for it instead of acting, which reads as a trigger failure when it is an eval-design failure.

evals.name: reads-like-ai
evals.prompt: draft-spec.md reads like ChatGPT wrote it. Fix it.
evals.why: The diagnostic complaint phrasing is the primary trigger.

evals.name: de-slop-the-doc
evals.prompt: De-slop draft-spec.md before I send it to the client.
evals.why: Direct request in the skill's own vocabulary, with a ship-it deadline.

evals.name: cringe-prose
evals.prompt: Go through draft-spec.md and take out the corny AI voice, the hedging and the em dashes. Keep what it actually says.
evals.why: Names three categories and states the preserve-meaning invariant without naming the skill.

evals.name: review-generated-prose-for-inventions
evals.prompt: An agent wrote draft-spec.md. Check it for anything it made up or contradicted itself on, and tidy the writing.
evals.why: Pass 2 is half the skill. Reviewing model output for hallucinations and contradictions must trigger it, not only the prose polish.

evals.name: polish-before-shipping
evals.prompt: I drafted draft-spec.md with an LLM. Make it sound like a person wrote it.
evals.why: Model-drafted text plus a humanise request.

evals.name: not-a-rewrite-request
evals.prompt: Rewrite draft-spec.md to argue for a database instead of a queue.
evals.why: Changing what a document argues is explicitly out of scope. Same file, opposite intent, so this isolates intent from file presence.

evals.name: not-a-code-refactor
evals.prompt: This function is ugly and hard to follow. Clean it up.
evals.why: Code logic is out of scope. 'Clean it up' alone must not fire this skill.

evals.name: not-ui-slop
evals.prompt: This landing page looks like every other AI-generated site. Make it less generic.
evals.why: Precision boundary against the sibling skill. Visual slop is frontend-aesthetics; prose slop is this one. Both complaints use 'AI-generated'.

evals.name: not-a-fresh-draft
evals.prompt: Write me a blog post about Iceberg table formats.
evals.why: Authoring from scratch is not an eraser pass.
